duplicate_and_failure_policy: Every cell primary origin is fixed by this committed registration before any local native measurement. It never depends on success, failure, runtime or resource observations.

Original GitHub150 workflow remains active and retains its independent complete evidence/301-artifact receiver. Its eventual1k observations are additional executions outside this study, retained under their own actual identities.
Do not replace a failed, slow, canceled, missing or capacity-refused local primary with a GitHub observation; any such primary leaves this study failed or incomplete.

Do not add duplicate IDs or count the additional executions toward the registered N30. A distinct future study must be explicitly registered and preserve these earlier outcomes; no silent fallback or best-of selection.
All150 primary cells and their original terminal/raw outcomes are required. Completion of the local1k cohort alone closes no TODO.
full_acceptance: Run unmodified original-G validate_build and validate_shard/inspect_raw for all150 preselected directories, then unmodified combine/aggregate with repetitions30, shard_count30 and scale_capacity_v1. Every source, binary, plan, unique global ID, all15-table parity, failure, deadline and complete group check remains required.

local_execution_policy.credentials: Use an explicit environment allowlist; no provider/authentication/proxy credentials are forwarded. Native generated semantic-disabled fixture remains original.
local_execution_policy.disk: Use owned root-volume output. Every run_shard must independently pass the original minimum; insufficient capacity remains not_run and stops the local cohort.
local_execution_policy.hosted_sdk_cleanup: Not invoked or spoofed locally. The original local-capable run_shard executes its own identical registered disk preflight for every cell and retains both disk receipts.
local_execution_policy.memory: Shared8GiB cgroup observed, no invented original threshold or guaranteed peak. One cell at a time. Actual memory/OOM failures remain failed evidence.
local_execution_policy.source_preparation: Create a new owned real Git checkout at the original compiled path; exact G HEAD/tree,1087complete inputs and both driver inputs; clean before/after. No aliases, source modifications, attribution relabeling or hosted-context spoofing.
local_execution_policy.storage: Preserve every original cell file and failure prefix. Create lossless verified archives and persist them to the repository; no deletion of unarchived evidence. If storage is insufficient, stop and record remaining planned cells as not_run.
local_execution_policy.supervision: Original native300min, Python302min and raw512MiB limits unchanged. No optional shorter timeout or lowered work profile.
